subject: general
question: On 29 April 2025, the Union Minister of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) Pralhad Joshi launched the GHCI scheme to empower MSMEs and promote green hydrogen economy. What is the full form of GHCI?

options.text: Green Hydrogen Certification Scheme of India
Green Hydrogen Cultivation Scheme of India
Green Hydrogen Channel Scheme of India
Green Hydrogen Conservation Scheme of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Green Hydrogen Certification Scheme of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Green Hydrogen Certification Scheme of India (GHCI)** was launched by **Union Minister of New and Renewable Energy, Pralhad Joshi,** on **29 April 2025**.
 
• The aim of the scheme is to **empower MSMEs (Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises)** and promote the **green hydrogen economy**, a crucial step toward achieving sustainability goals.
 
• The scheme focuses on the **certification of green hydrogen production** to ensure that it is produced using renewable energy sources, adhering to global standards for carbon neutrality.
 
• The GHCI will provide a framework for **monitoring, verifying, and certifying green hydrogen**, enabling India to establish itself as a reliable supplier of green hydrogen in the global market.
 
• This initiative aligns with India’s commitment to achieving **net-zero emissions by 2070** and its **National Hydrogen Energy Mission**, announced in 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Green Hydrogen:**

 
 
• **Green hydrogen** is produced through the process of **electrolysis** of water using renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, or hydropower.
 
• It is considered a **clean energy source** as it produces no carbon emissions, making it crucial for decarbonizing industries like steel, cement, and transportation.
 
• Global demand for green hydrogen is expected to **increase exponentially** as countries aim to meet their climate targets under the Paris Agreement.
 
 
 
• **Role of MSMEs in the Green Hydrogen Economy:**
 
 
• MSMEs play a significant role in manufacturing and innovation within the green hydrogen supply chain.
 
• The GHCI scheme is expected to provide these enterprises with **financial incentives, technical support, and market access** to adopt green hydrogen technologies.
 
 
 
• **National Hydrogen Energy Mission:**
 
 
• Launched in **2021**, this mission focuses on the production and export of green hydrogen to position India as a global leader in clean energy.
 
• The mission seeks to reduce India’s dependence on fossil fuels and **achieve energy self-reliance**.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Countries like **Germany, Japan, and Australia** are investing heavily in green hydrogen as a part of their energy transition strategies.
 
• The certification process under GHCI will align India’s green hydrogen production with **international standards**, enhancing its export potential.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Green Hydrogen:**

 
 
• Green hydrogen is expected to replace fossil fuels in energy-intensive sectors and contribute to reducing **global greenhouse gas emissions**.
 
• It is also a key component of India's strategy to become a **global leader in renewable energy**.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Adopting Green Hydrogen:**
 
 
• The production of green hydrogen is currently **cost-intensive** due to the high costs of renewable energy and electrolyzers.
 
• GHCI aims to address these challenges by fostering innovation and scaling up production technologies to reduce costs.
